prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a parking lot collision. The patient had 11 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1141; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with pain and swelling over the distal radius of the left wrist. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm a distal radius fracture. Over the course of 11 visits, the patient was managed with immobilization, progressive range-of-motion exercises, and scheduled follow-up imaging to monitor alignment and healing. Treatment followed a usual course and tapered as the patient improved, with pain and function steadily returning. The patient reports a remote strain in the same region years ago that resolved completely without lasting limitation. At this time it is not yet clear whether the present injury arose from this crash, and causation review is ongoing. Billing records show no repeated charges for the same services. Discharge plan includes home exercise instructions and return precautions, with reassessment as needed.
